headword: {救援|きゅうえん}{物資|ぶっし}

definitions.explanation: Goods and materials provided to people affected by disasters, wars, or other emergencies. Includes food, water, medicine, blankets, and other essentials.

examples.japanese: {救援|きゅうえん}{物資|ぶっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
⟦{被災地|ひさいち}→被災地：27434_hisaichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{救援|きゅうえん}{物資|ぶっし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: Relief supplies arrived at the disaster-affected area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧{救援|きゅうえん}{物資|ぶっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕分|しわ}け→仕分ける：20080_shiwakeru⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The work of sorting relief supplies gathered from various areas and distributing them to evacuation shelters continues.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound noun frequently used in disaster and humanitarian aid contexts. Japan experiences frequent natural disasters, so this term appears regularly in news reports about earthquake, typhoon, and flood relief efforts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {救援|きゅうえん}{物資|ぶっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{送|おく}る→送る：00742_okuru⟧ (to send relief supplies)
- {救援|きゅうえん}{物資|ぶっし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧ (to deliver relief supplies)
- {救援|きゅうえん}{物資|ぶっし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{配布|はいふ}→配布：14410_haifu⟧ (distribution of relief supplies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧: support supplies — broader, not limited to emergencies
- {義援金|ぎえんきん}: relief donations, monetary aid — financial rather than material support
